caption: The drawing depicts a repeating pattern set against a muted terracotta-colored background. The main elements consist of stylized floral and fruit motifs outlined in white and black, with accents of red and blue. The composition is arranged in a diamond lattice formed by thin, wavy white lines intersecting at floral-like knots, enclosing the motifs within each diamond. Within the diamonds, there are two prominent types of forms: one that resembles a white, leafy flower or fruit with a red center and small black details, and another that looks like a cluster of blue and red circular fruits with white highlights, attached to stems with small leaves. Smaller black leafy details are interspersed between the larger motifs. At the top of the image, there is a horizontal border that incorporates interlocking red loops, white outlines, and occasional blue accents, set over the same terracotta background. The overall appearance is flat and stylized, featuring a limited color palette of terracotta, white, black, red, and blue. The bottom section of the image is left blank.
title: Hand Painted Wall (Detail)
